name: 短视频制作
description: 从一个主题做出一条竖屏短视频：脚本 → 分镜 → 素材 → 剪辑 → 导出。每一步都可以回看、修改、重跑。 / Make a vertical short video from a topic: script → storyboard → assets → edit → export. Every step can be reviewed, edited and re-run.

topic.description: 视频主题，例如：为什么猫喜欢纸箱 / What the video is about, e.g. why cats love boxes

duration.description: 目标时长（秒） / Target length in seconds

style.description: 风格和语气，例如：轻松科普、温暖治愈 / Tone and style, e.g. light explainer, warm and cozy

audience.description: 目标观众 / Who the video is for
audience.default: 短视频平台的普通观众

language.description: 输出语言：zh 中文，en English。决定脚本、分镜、字幕和剪辑/导出日志的语言 / Output language: zh or en. Sets the language of the script, storyboard, captions and the edit/export logs

stages.name: 脚本
stages.description: 根据主题写口播脚本，分成几段，每段一句话的画面提示。 / Write a voiceover script from the topic, in parts, each with a one-line visual note.

stages.name: 分镜
stages.description: 把脚本拆成镜头：每个镜头的时长、画面、字幕和需要的素材文件名。 / Split the script into shots: duration, visual, caption and asset file name for each.

stages.name: 素材
stages.description: 按分镜准备图片或视频。 / Prepare images or videos for the storyboard.

executor.instructions: 把图片或视频放进 assets/，文件名对应 storyboard.json 里每个镜头的 asset 字段。缺的镜头导出时会用文字卡代替，所以也可以先放一个空的 assets/ 文件夹（mkdir assets）。可选：自己录的配音命名为 voice.mp3，背景音乐命名为 music.mp3，也放进 assets/。 / Put images or videos in assets/, named after each shot's asset field in storyboard.json. Missing shots become text cards on export, so an empty assets/ folder (mkdir assets) also works. Optional: a voiceover you recorded as voice.mp3 and background music as music.mp3, also in assets/.

stages.name: 剪辑
stages.description: 把分镜和素材排成时间线。生成后可以直接改 timeline.json 调整顺序、时长和字幕。 / Lay out the storyboard and assets as a timeline. You can edit timeline.json afterwards to change order, durations and captions.

stages.name: 导出
stages.description: 用 FFmpeg 把时间线渲染成 MP4。 / Render the timeline to MP4 with FFmpeg.
